$sources: The species: Nymphaea alba L., the European white water lily: leaves 10-30 cm across, flowers 10-20 cm, white, floating (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Nymphaeaceae).
Colours and the colony rule: the as-built museum's lily colonies (windows/Source/MuseeVision/Nature/MuseeWaterLilies.cpp).
name: Nymphaea alba
note: The wild species the Marliac hybrids were bred from; the stage contract's example planting.
